sources_considered.why: Peer-reviewed deployment trial includes economic modeling, while clearly separating projected savings from observed outcomes.
Checked methods to establish that the underlying trial occurred in January and February 2025.
Consumer willingness-to-accept estimates do not directly establish realized net financial gains from successive model improvements.
The authors explicitly lack full deployment costs and cannot directly estimate return on investment.

evidence_items.explanation: The randomized trial found no significant overall documentation-time reduction, although some subgroups improved. Its favorable financial result is an annual savings projection, not a measurement of realized net savings or the incremental value of a newer model.

unresolved_gaps: The selected studies do not establish realized benefits net of all relevant costs attributable specifically to improved model capabilities.
No comprehensive evidence establishes that every participant lacks an economically worthwhile use.
The claim does not distinguish incremental model improvement from adoption of LLMs generally.
